slides.title: Surface Laptop Ultra with Local AI
slides.subtitle: Hybrid AI for consultants on the go

slides.title: Consultant Workflows
slides.takeaway: Like a chef with two kitchens
slides.notes: Consultants draft summaries using two AI lanes. Main kitchen (Copilot) for general work. Side kitchen (local AI) for sensitive, repeated tasks. Like a chef using both kitchens.

slides.title: Local AI Architecture
slides.notes: Local AI runs entirely on the device. 28 open models are pre-installed. The RTX Spark GPU handles processing, with 128 GB of memory for complex tasks.

slides.title: Consultant Workflow
slides.takeaway: Two AI lanes for two tasks
slides.notes: Consultants take notes during interviews. They draft summaries using either Copilot (for general tasks) or local AI (for sensitive, repeated work). Final review and send.

slides.title: Cloud vs Local AI

data.verdict: Local AI for sensitive, repeated drafting tasks

slides.notes: Cloud AI requires internet and sends data to the cloud. Local AI works offline and keeps data on device. Best for sensitive, repeated drafting work.

slides.title: Device Capacity

data.caption: Surface Laptop Ultra with RTX Spark

slides.notes: The Surface Laptop Ultra has 128 GB of memory. It supports running 28 open models locally, with room for processing and user data.

slides.title: AI Use Cases
slides.notes: A hybrid approach. Use Copilot for sensitive low-repetition tasks and high-sensitivity, high-repetition tasks with local AI.

slides.title: Time Savings Estimate

data.caption: Estimate based on 5 min per summary

slides.notes: If local AI saves 5 minutes per summary, the potential annual time savings are 27,600 hours. This is an estimate to validate during the pilot.

slides.title: Pilot Plan
slides.notes: The pilot will test the local AI solution with 10 users for two weeks. Metrics include task time, draft quality, and user experience. Goal is to validate the use case.

slides.title: Key Insight
slides.takeaway: Local AI adds value without replacing Copilot

data.text: Local AI enhances workflows, not replaces them

slides.notes: Local AI is not a replacement for Microsoft 365 Copilot. It adds a second lane for sensitive, repeated drafting work.

slides.title: Next Steps

data.ask: Approve the pilot to validate local AI for consultants

slides.notes: We propose a 10-user, 2-week pilot with Surface Laptop Ultra. This will validate the use case and inform future decisions on local AI adoption.
